name: Tmux
author: Maximilian-Maag
description: Themes the installed tmux from the applied Omarchy theme: reads the live colors.toml and generates a tmux theme conf (status bar, active/inactive window, selection, accent) that your own tmux.conf sources, plus a Hyprland keybinding.

features: Reads the applied theme live from ~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme/colors.toml — no baked-in palette, any theme works
Generates ~/.config/tmux/omarchy-theme.conf (status bar, active/inactive window, selection, accent, pane borders)
Writes to a dedicated file so your existing ~/.config/tmux/tmux.conf is never modified beyond a source-file line
theme-set hook regenerates and reloads the conf on every theme change
Hyprland keybinding (Super+Shift+Alt+T) opens a tmux session in a floating terminal
status reports the applied theme, the generated file and the tmux version
